resource: R7 P03 XP award descendants committed per creature death
allocation_impact: Enforced structurally, not by a counted check: settle_creature_death_rewards issues at most one commit_character_experience call per invocation, keyed by an ExperienceRewardOccurrence the physical Channel owner mints once per (death, character) and memoizes for the rest of the generation; a repeated composition call for the same death reuses that occurrence and resolves to the same already-committed receipt rather than a second descendant.
boundary_tests: max=1: one settle_creature_death_rewards call commits exactly one XP receipt (one_creature_death_mints_the_plan_and_awards_xp_once, PG)

max+1: a second settle_creature_death_rewards call for the same death reuses the memoized occurrence and leaves the XP receipt count at 1, not 2 (replay_is_idempotent_with_no_duplicate_mint_or_xp, PG)
consumers: apps/game-server/src/foundation/runtime_actor_carrier.rs (CurrentOwnerCombatDeath::reward_occurrence: mints the occurrence at most once per (death, character) and memoizes it)
notes: Resource rows decision §4.1 row 9. DUR-03 decision §4.2: "the Combat owner mints one server UUIDv7 ExperienceRewardOccurrence per (death, eligible character) ... every retry in that generation reuses it." Registered by OTV2-20260928-combat-d2b-death-reward-wiring.
